clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Krom Stoutarm studies the darker arts in the Hall of Explorers. A dwarven scholar and warlock, he reads arcane texts and demonic rites in the library, and guides Alliance warlocks seeking esoteric knowledge across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

Krom Stoutarm pursues occult lore in the Hall of Explorers. While dwarven archaeologists there focus on picks, shovels, and titan artifacts, Krom studies massive tomes and the rites used to bind demons. His work gives a warlock’s craft a place within Ironforge’s mountain halls, though many distrust those arts.

Alliance warlocks seeking to bind powerful demons such as the felhunter turn to Krom Stoutarm. He knows of occult volumes scattered across distant lands and directs summoners to recover torn pages and fragments of the infamous Tome of the Cabal, including from the centaur of Thousand Needles.
